name: warranty-registration
title: Warranty registration
description: Register a purchase for its warranty: serial number, purchase date and shop, proof of purchase, then the end date of the cover, shown before sending.
docs: Pass product ({ name, model?, image? }) when you know it: it is shown beside the form and the form does not ask for it; without it the form has a Product field. warrantyMonths (default 24) says how long the cover runs from the day of purchase. As soon as a day is chosen the form says 'Covered until 14 March 2028' before anything is sent, and a day in the future, or so old that the cover has already ended, is refused in words. serialPattern is a regular expression (a RegExp, or a string with its source, which can cross from a Server Component and is matched without regard to case): a serial number that does not fit is explained, with serialExample quoted ('It looks like HX-4821-K9Q2'; the same example is the empty field's placeholder, written 'For example HX-4821-K9Q2' so the field never looks filled in), and serialHelp says where the number is printed. The proof of purchase is one file up to maxFileSize bytes (default 5 MB) and is required unless proofRequired is false. onSubmit(values) receives { product, serial, purchaseDate (yyyy-mm-dd), store, proof (a File, or null), consent, coveredUntil (yyyy-mm-dd) }. Return a message and the form stays with every answer in it, the receipt's name too, and says so in a notice that takes focus; return nothing, or resolve, and the form is replaced by the confirmation: the end of the cover as the one big fact, what was registered, what is covered (covers) and what is not (excludes). Return { reference } to print the registration's reference there, or pass submitted to show the confirmation for a registration your page already holds. defaultValues fills the shop and the day for a customer who comes from an order. now and timeZone decide which calendar day 'today' is (pass now from the server so the first render matches the browser's), locale writes the dates, privacyHref turns the consent line into a link, headingAs is 'h3' inside a section that has its own h2, and labels holds every fixed word for another language.
